sermon.title: Fruitless Believers 07/15/2018
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer explains Satan’s third weapon: the seed among thorns, where the cares of this world, the deceit of riches and the lusts of this life choke the word so believers bear no fruit. Fruit means character and others coming to Christ. Unanswered prayer and an unhealed land trace back to fruitlessness, and the fruit of the Spirit, led by love, is available to everyone.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Garbled words, including a name in the National Day of Prayer remark, are marked [unclear]. Kept as spoken: electrons “drawn by gravity” toward the nucleus (34:47). Unverified: science about six years ago said sugar is good for kids; scares about milk cartons and cranberry sauce causing cancer (18:08). Sensitive content kept as spoken: anyone who learned nothing from the worship is “just brain-dead” (14:46). Same-sex marriage a “low level” of “permissive sin”; transgender identity “nonsense”, “everybody is getting dumber”, the Supreme Court (24:08–26:25). Legalizing marijuana. “They never quarantine the homosexuals … oh no we can’t be cruel to the homosexual” (27:20). Mocked his parents while he believed evolution (36:00).
